content:
I am a software engineer interested in distributed architecture, high-performance computing, and low-latency systems. Currently, I work at Nvidia as a system software engineer intern in the hardware infrastructure department, focusing on improving stability for Nemotron pretraining.
Previously, I have worked with multiplayer gaming systems, nuclear fusion, and quantum computing.
I also enjoy competitive programming and currently serve as the president of the SFU Competitive Programming Club. Alongside this, I conduct systems research as a research assistant in the SFU Database Systems Lab.
In my personal time, I love going to the gym, playing board games, and reading books.
